corpus: RAG vs long-context LLMs (16 arXiv papers, data/corpus/)
description: 37 paraphrased questions. Relevance is labelled as (source, page): the pages where the answer is explicitly stated (abstract, method, or results), never bibliography entries. Draft labels were located by reading candidate passages and need the user's review (eval/review/). Types: fact = one paper answers it; multi = needs several papers; conflict = papers disagree, so a good result shows both sides; unanswerable = the corpus doesn't cover it (no labels; used to check whether scores can signal 'no evidence').
